findings.body: The comment states the test "asserts the error", but the test does not call any error-producing function; it builds the GatewayModel directly and then asserts the output of `reasoning_options`. This could mislead future readers into thinking an error path is covered. Update the comment to accurately describe the test's approach.
findings.title: Fix the comment that claims an error is asserted

value.summary: The change adds a configurable reasoning_effort field to GatewayModel and wires it into OpenRouter provider options with tests. The implementation is correct; only a minor comment in a test is misleading.
